description: Every song padded with comment lines to 60 KiB, the manifest listing the padded files: the uncompressed total is 37 times the ZIP file size, above the 20 times of FDS 3.5 (a zip-bomb guard). The songs stay under 64 KiB, so only the ratio fails; were it not Fatal, each song would also give SNG-17 (larger than 8 KiB).
